s4_minimax_ships_m3_1_flash_cutting.text: Shanghai-based MiniMax launched M3.1 Flash on 19 October, claiming "generational" gains in agent tasks, coding and cybersecurity, almost three times faster online inference and about 70% lower usage costs, Reuters reported.

s5_seoul_hosts_the_first_global_ai.text: South Korea's science ministry and the World Bank Group opened the three-day Global AI & Digital Summit in Seoul on 19 October, with officials from about 60 countries plus companies and researchers, Yonhap reported.
